cases.disposition_reason: TablePro with no --page flag opens Connections at 120×40 in truecolor with reduced motion. The landing lists Development and does not show Query 1. A click on Development shows host dev-db.internal.acme.io and database acme_dev. Connect finishes on Query 1 in catalog acme_prod › public, with status Connected to Development and the empty editor placeholder Type SQL. The status is not Loading schema, and EXPLAIN · raw is absent. The route keeps no baseline.
cases.entry_path: launch tablepro --color truecolor --motion reduced at 120x40 with no --page flag; click Development; click Connect
cases.return_path: the workbench is already Query 1; the route keeps no baseline

cases.disposition_reason: On Development, the Query 1 editor receives SELECT sku FROM products. Development Safe Mode stays Silent, so EXPLAIN of this SELECT does not open a confirm dialog. Ctrl+X finishes on the plan tree: header Operation, node Seq Scan, status Planning 0.210 ms · r Raw, and no EXPLAIN · raw card. The plan is not Gather, Parallel Seq Scan, or Sort. A click on the Seq Scan row moves focus to the plan, and r toggles the raw card. The editor still contains SELECT sku FROM products. The raw card is titled EXPLAIN · raw, shows Planning Time: 0.210 ms and Seq Scan on public.products (cost=0.00..15.90 rows=312 width=64), and does not show Operation. That raw card is the 120×40 frame. The 80×24 frame, captured before the terminal returns to 120×40, still shows EXPLAIN · raw and Planning Time:. Alt+X then runs EXPLAIN ANALYZE. Its status is Planning 0.210 ms · Execution 0.466 ms, which is not the tree-only Operation header. Ctrl+Q opens Quit TablePro? for the unsaved query; confirming Quit exits 0.
cases.action_sequence: Explain a statement, switch to the raw plan, and run EXPLAIN ANALYZE where the mode allows it.
cases.expected_results: Each body contains that view's text.
cases.forbidden_effects: The raw view still shows only the tree.
